releaseInfo.releaseNotes:
Hypergamous Tree Chopping Simulator 3 - Update 1.2.6

- PRESTIGE FIX: the Prestige card now shows the log stockpile you need (rebirth 50 cost x (prestige+2)) and how many you have. It no longer says "buy the remaining 0 axes" when logs are the real blocker.
- GOLDEN TREES: a glowing star appears on the chop screen every so often. Click it for a x7 log frenzy, a big log burst, or an egg bounty.
- LUMBERJACK CONTRACTS: three rotating goals (chop, earn logs, click golden trees) paying shards, eggs or logs. Every 25th contract gives a Prestige Vault token.
- PRESTIGE PERKS: each Prestige gives a perk point. Spend it on Golden Touch, Fat Contracts, Seasoned Roots or Foreman (auto-buys axes). Your existing prestiges already count.
- Fixed text that said there were five prestiges (it is ten).
